name: Cal Kestis' second lightsaber
description: This lightsaber was created by Jedi Padawan Cal Kestis when he went to Ilum after damaging his previous weapon. The weapon was created by combining parts from Cere Junda's lightsaber and his former deceased master Jaro Tapal's lightsaber.

data.name: Cal Kestis' second lightsaber
data.creator: Cal Kestis

data.mods: Hilt allows user to switch between single-bladed Jar'Kai, double-bladed, or crossguard
